message.Title: Public Preview: Perimeter link (cross perimeter) in network security perimeter

Body.Content:
This capability enables secure connectivity between resources protected by different network security perimeters, while maintaining strong perimeter-based access controls. 

With this release, customers can confidently adopt network security perimeter across complex, distributed application architectures that require controlled communication across security perimeters. 

Learn more.
